_doc: The society model's parameters (docs/society.md §12), read by the calculator tools/society_calc.gd (society_plan.md step 0) and later by sim.soc. No player-visible texts. Units: a day is 90 s (data.gd DAY_LEN); food in the game's food units; hands = workers. Each level is the set of methods in use at a reference size N.

day._doc: The working day's time budget (model §2), seconds of a 90 s day: awake time, then meals and everyday life; work is what is left after the walk.

walk._doc: speed: paces a second (mirrors sim.unit_speed's base 58); indoor: the walk share of work done at home or in a workshop (everything but food); cap: the most of a working day the walk may take.

people._doc: children: share of the people; unwell: share of grown-ups sick, badly hurt or away (not workers); child_eats: a child's hunger, of a grown-up's at rest (rules.json survival.child_hunger).

spoil_free._doc: Food in store that does not spoil (sim.gd: spoilage acts only on the stock above 30).

tools._doc: Tools as a good that wears (model §3.1): a food hand wears out one tool in wear_days; a toolmaker makes make_per_day. Toolmakers are counted as food hands.

values._doc: What the tribe values, per person (model §8): the channels' weights. Fitted knobs, ordered mortality > labour, losses > contentment.

impact._doc: How much of each channel a need moves when it is not covered at all, against food's (model §8: V_need = sum of value x impact over the channels it feeds). Food uncovered kills everyone (mortality 1); untreated sickness kills far fewer, so health's mortality impact is small. Food has two windows: now (mortality and contentment) and the horizon (growth, and the winter's mortality discounted by delta to the stores' run-out day). Fitted knobs.

food._doc: base: food a second at work for a hand before the factors (fitted so the band's R lands in its band). Sources: season = yield per season [spring, summer, autumn, winter]; rel = rate against a field hand; method: whether the level's method factor applies (the fields' plough and irrigation do, the wild and the hunt don't; the hunt stands for all the winter sources: the hunt, fishing, the pens). A source is land-limited by the level's Y (food a day at a season factor of 1; 0 = no limit).

order._doc: Order (model §6): a_c coordination per head once a Steward exists; a_d disputes past n0, growing with exponent k; an informal keeper's span shrinks past n1; institutions (the Council, the Code) multiply span by code_mult. In hands at span 1.

health._doc: Per-head incidence grows with density, density_k on N against n_ref (model §6: density ∝ N^0.3, incidence ∝ density^0.5).

safety._doc: Safety's demand: max(vigilance per head, threat per head × (N / n_ref)^wealth_k) (model §4.1, §6).

work._doc: How the game follows the model (read by sim.gd and society.gd). skill_curve: the work multiplier by skill level 0..10, one concave curve for every kind of work (model §3: x1.0 to x1.4); gather: the gathering rate per resource against the game's base rates (food 0.25: the game's gathering brought down to the model's band, society.md §14.1, open #11). The Steward's allocation (society.gd, step 4): rates: what a full-time hand brings in a day of each resource until measured (every measure_every s, a running mean of weight measure_k; a full-time hand works job_secs a day); band_below: under this many people the tribe is a band, else its village's tier is the level; walk_food: the walk's share on top of the hunger at rest (a food hand's yield by season is the game's own: events.json seasons yields and berries, a find's winter flag, half the herds gone in winter: society.gd food_factor); stock_needs: the stocks the Steward keeps and the need each serves (covered by the stock and the hands on it against rules.json vice.steward needs); hand_needs: work covered by hands (crafts, rites, building) and its need (hands per head from levels.<level>.hands; the hands on it averaged over avg_secs, as a carving takes only moments); reserve_days: food's today window asks for today's eating and this many days of it in store (meals and births draw on the stores, not on the day's gathering); secure_from, secure_to: births and newcomers follow food security, from the look-ahead coverage secure_from (none) to secure_to (all the beds allow), a step when equal (society.gd food_security); by_challenge: overrides of any of these per challenge level; food_buffer: the look-ahead coverage food is kept to (food security for births, model §10, open #2); skills: the skill each choice is worked with (a person's productivity at it, with their trade's edge at their own trade); min_weight: below this a choice is not worth a hand (rest). One rule for everyone (society.gd best_for): each person works where their hand is worth most, the work's weight times their productivity at it; the Steward places by it, and a person with a trade goes to it by themselves only when it is their best work; with no Steward, an idle grown-up chooses their own work by it after self_secs of idleness.

by_challenge._doc: Overrides of these work knobs per challenge level (hz.level: off, normal, harsh), as director.json's levels: e.g. {"off": {"gather": {"food": 0.4}, "secure_from": 1.0}}. The designer's knobs between growth and the band's hunger trap, set against make_it_fun.md G1's bands (society.md 14.6, open #12); none set yet.

goods._doc: Goods that wear (model §3.1, society.gd): made indoors at home (the job craft: hidden, sheltered) from `cost` in `work` seconds by a hand with `skill` (doing `doing`, shown as `act`), opened by `when` (story.holds). Each grown-up wants `per_worker` of it; coverage = stock / (grown-ups x per_worker), and the work it `uses` (resources gathered, food from fields) goes up to `max` times as fast at full coverage (1 + (max - 1) x B(coverage)). Hands at that work wear `wear` a day each. Its price for the one rule is what one more maker's day saves: the rise in the multiplier times the hands on the work it serves, each valued at the best use of a hand.

jobs._doc: Which need a job in the game serves (tools/metrics.gd's society report, society_plan.md step 1): keys are a job type, or type:resource for gathering; the columns are the share table's. A job not listed counts as other.

levels._doc: Per level: N (reference size), factors (the productivity budget, model §3), walk (share of a food hand's working time spent walking at N; grows as √(N / N) away from it), spoil (share of the stores lost a day: pots, granaries, the smokehouse), steward, institutions, import (share of food bought or paid in tribute), Y (land limits per source, food a day), and hands per head of each other need at full coverage (the labour cost l times the units per head: health's is care per case, safety's the threat, order's a multiplier on its formula).

targets._doc: The share of hands per need the design intends (model §6), and each level's R band (model §7). The calculator compares its year averages with these.
